title: Table in Acts
prompt: High-fidelity desktop ecommerce comp for Maleny Cuisine. Preserve the established paper, ivory and chocolate visual system. Use the exact Spicy Tomato Relish pack and Maleny Cuisine logo. Slim announcement strip and existing centered-logo header. Create a spacious asymmetric split: monumental jar still life at left, purchase column at right with verified product title, price, serving line, dietary claims, quantity and Add to Cart. Reveal a Made for the table serving ribbon below. Flat at rest, near-square controls, fine hairlines, no invented commerce or review claims.
